mainline_contract.target: WT = raw labels {1,2,3}; raw label 4 excluded
mainline_contract.click_protocol: three accumulated GT-derived corrective clicks with recurrent low-resolution mask prompt
mainline_contract.stage1: braincrop SAM-Med3D automatic localization remains unchanged
mainline_contract.stage2: native 128^3 SAM-Med3D crop and click-3 checkpoint remains frozen

hypothesis: The remaining binding error is stage-2 segmentation generalization rather than localization. A full-resolution 3D residual refiner conditioned on T1ce and the frozen SAM click-3 raw logit can learn systematic extent and small-lesion corrections while preserving the existing SAM result at initialization.

arm.name: t1ce_wt_stage2_samlogit_segresnet_residual_v1
input_channels: tanh(frozen stage-2 SAM click-3 raw logit / 5)
arm.zero_initialization: the final residual convolution is zero, so epoch 0 must exactly reproduce the frozen SAM DSC
arm.backbone: MONAI SegResNet, init_filters=16, blocks_down=[1,2,2,4], blocks_up=[1,1,1], dropout=0.1
arm.sampling: replacement sampling weighted by clipped sqrt(median lesion volume / lesion volume), range [0.5,4]
arm.augmentation: joint axis flips and zero-filled translations up to 12 voxels; T1ce-only scale, offset, and Gaussian noise

gates.engineering_smoke: 4 train + 4 validation cases; cache baseline finite; epoch-0 delta exactly zero; two optimizer epochs complete with finite gradients and checkpoint round-trip
gates.full_cache_baseline: validation cached click-3 DSC must reproduce the frozen gt-crop stage-2 readout within 1e-4
gates.automatic_cascade_gate: only if development_success passes, evaluate the same frozen refiner under stage-1-predicted crop geometry on validation
gates.test_gate: no sealed-test access without a separate frozen automatic-cascade configuration and new explicit user authorization

prediction_registered_before_run.reason: The refiner directly attacks the full-resolution extent error and paper ablations report a positive refinement effect, but train-time gt-centered crops and the small T1ce-only information budget may still limit generalization.
